title: Supply Trace
tagline: Transparent tracking and provenance of supply chain. |  Built using sign protocol
description:
This project combines sign protocol attestations to allow transparent tracking and provenance of supply chain
Features : 
- Transparent tracking of goods using attestations.
- Auditable trail of product journey for tax compliance and better supply chain management.
- Verify authenticity and origin of goods.
how_its_made:
Problem Statement :
- No Transparency and Traceability leading to fake and low quality goods
- Compliance and Auditing Challenges

Our Solution :
Supply Tracce protocol uses @eth-sign/xyz to create schemas and attestations for transactions in supply chain. We create a linked chain of attestations which are queried and stored on Arbitrum Sepolia testnet.
We have built a react frontend app to demo capabilities of our protocol such as:
- Inventory Management
- On-chain Attestations for transactions between market participants
- Past Transactions and Audit Reports generations for taxation and compliance.
- Verifications to prove the origin and trail of a product history
